A [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] '''criminal''' was responsible for many atrocities against the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] clan known as [[Strongfist clan|Strongfist]]. A [[Wanted Poster: Trandoshan|wanted poster]] for them was created sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trandoshan criminal appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which was developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. Their appearance consisted of their picture being used for the aforementioned wanted poster and the poster's description indicating their crimes leading to the poster's creation.<ref name="SWG" />
